statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let K := fun (X p q : ℕ) => ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ q≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p) ∧ Nat.Prime (n-q))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, (∑ n ∈ E X, H X n * (H X n - 1)) = ∑ p ∈ P X, ∑ q ∈ (P X).erase p, K X p q

plain_statement.zh: 把碰撞矩分解成不同小素数对的共同终点
plain_statement.en: Resolve factorial collisions into shared endpoints

brief.zh: 数同一终点的两条不同路径。排除相同第一步，避免把对角线送进两素数筛。
brief.en: Count ordered distinct paths arriving together and remove the diagonal before applying a two-prime sieve.
